name: The Scent of Lar'korwi

faq.answer: Torwa Pathfinder makes his camp near the entrance into Un'Goro Crater.
Torwa Pathfinder asks you to collect two ravasaur pheromone glands from the beasts in Un'Goro Crater.
The crater lies south of Tanaris, and Torwa watches the path that leads down into the wilds.

sections.body: At the edge of Un'Goro Crater, Torwa Pathfinder watches the dangerous beasts that roam the lowlands. He seeks ravasaur pheromone glands to aid his hunt. Tracking such predators requires facing the ravasaurs that hunt in the brush below.
sections.title: Tracking in the Crater

summary: Torwa Pathfinder waits near the entrance to Un'Goro Crater, studying the ferocious beasts of the basin. To assist his hunt, he asks you to bring him two ravasaur pheromone glands.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Scent of Lar'korwi
